external_collaboration.evidence_quote: We’ve partnered with the wonderful wine merchant Honest Grapes, based in London to help you with your wine orders for your Enrica Rocca Cooking Class. Family friend and wine guru Tom Harrow who runs Honest Grapes has curated a selection of wines that complements our current seasonal menu for you to choose from. You can order your wines directly here and we will organise for the delivery of wines to arrive in time for your cooking class.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Enrica Rocca is a family run cooking school and event space in Notting Hill and Venice. The Rocca family opened the London school in 2002 in what was once their family home, sharing their love for Italian hospitality and food. This hidden gem in West London is run by Rocca sisters, Charlotte and Claire, who share their skills in Italian home cooking at its best whilst Venice is run by mamma Enrica.
